tweet_text:
good start, but so much apophenia left on the table!

Full Names Whose Successive Levenshtein Distances Appear In OEIS A375110: 'Lexicographically Earliest Sequence Of Positive Integers Such That The Pairs (a(n) mod a(n+1), a(n+1)) Are All Distinct'

references.name: On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS)
references.evidence: Explicitly referenced in the tweet text, and sequence values are tracked and displayed in the top-left corner of the video frames.

references.name: Vladimir Levenshtein
references.evidence: The text and animation measure successive Levenshtein distances (edit distance) between names, a computational metric named after him.

result.one_line: A minimalist generative animation visualizing a sequence of names mutating into each other based on Levenshtein distances matching OEIS sequence A375110.
